newsitem.title: HONG KONG: Tourism/trade may build on Vietnam/Macau airlink.
newsitem.headline: Tourism/trade may build on Vietnam/Macau airlink.

text.p: HONG KONG, Nov 27 - Better tourism and trade links should be established between Vietnam and Macau following the November 8 start-up of a service linking Macau and Ho Chi Minh City, industry sources said.

"Pacific Airlines is the 18th scheduled carrier to fly into Macau airport and adds another country destination to a growing list. Vietnam is forecast to grow rapidly and it is a good connection to have," said a spokesman for Macau International airport which is one year old next month.
The twice weekly direct link is operated by Vietnam's Pacific Airlines returning via Da Nang using Boeing 737-300s that it leases from Hong Kong based Trinity Group.
Trinity managing Director Stephen Miller said the airline expects both tourist and trade links to be established because of ease of travel.

"It is quite easy for Vietnamese people to get a visa for Macau and for passengers from Macau and the Pearl River delta, procedural formalities are similar when they visit Vietnam," Miller said. -- Air Cargo Newsroom Tel+44 171 542 7706 Fax+44 171 542 5017
